description: Eval set. Each request runs twice: 'defaults' (turn 2 = defaults) and 'scripted' (turn 2 = letter codes from 'plan' against the actual round-one questions; a second answer, 'second_answer' or 'defaults', is sent only if the first did not settle the brief). expect=build requests must build on turn 1 with no question. vague-a is contaminated by the worked example and is not in the set (see requests.md).

requests.text: Create a workflow that builds a clickable prototype of the approval portal from the attached requirement documents.

Write a launch email for the new billing module. 150 to 200 words, friendly, for existing customers. Include the date 1 December and the link to the release notes.
